concept.name: Goblin Warchanter
concept.description: Goblin bard 1 from the supplied photograph, represented as an unbuffed base statblock. Printed temporary bonuses and discrepancies are documented in docs/goblin-warchanter-assessment.md.

details.sourceNotes: Base statistics exclude temporary performance bonuses. Printed attacks and fear/charm bonus apparently include inspire courage +1. Printed shortbow damage omits the Strength penalty; unbuffed damage is 1d4-1. Armored Ride is +7, not the printed +8. The potion and coins are descriptive inventory and supply no automatic base-statblock effects or prices.
details.tactics: Continue bardic performance, use whip to trip PCs, cast hideous laughter on a dangerous PC, and cure light wounds on herself after first being wounded.
